name: Precious Memento
text: Limit 1 Precious Memento (From a Future Life) per deck. [reaction] After you fail a skill test by 2 or more, exhaust Precious Memento: Heal 1 horror from it. [reaction] After you succeed at a skill test by 2 or more, exhaust Precious Memento: Heal 1 damage from it.
text_cn: 每副牌组限制1张珍贵记忆(来自后世)。 [reaction]在你技能检定失败且低于难度至少2点后，消耗珍贵记忆：治愈其1点恐惧。 [reaction]在你技能检定成功且超过难度至少2点后，消耗珍贵记忆：治愈其1点伤害。
